source.label: From the Edmonton Branch Cookbook, circa 1930?

items: 2½ lb pork roast, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.body: Mix **4 Tbsp cornstarch**, **2 cups tomato juice**, **1 cup vinegar**, **1 cup brown sugar** and **1 tsp soy sauce**.

steps.title: Brown the pork
steps.body: Brown **2½ lb pork roast**, cut into 1-inch cubes, mushrooms, sliced, if desired, and bell pepper, chopped, if desired.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Pour sauce over pork and simmer just until pork is done.
